Red Racing Stripes Vinyl Wrap

From our professional designer creating this remarkable design that was printed then wrapped by our experienced vehicle wrap installer in our shop, it looks clean and amazing!
We used 3M Wrap Film Series 1080 to wrap the car with cool racing stripes. Have a look at our What we Use page for 3M wrap colours and finishes we have available.
If you like what we do and wants to get more update for our latest work, follow our social media, like for support and leave some comments so that we know what you are thinking about our wraps!
